purpose: Select at most one genuinely new Campaign139 mechanism from already accepted historically dated local sources, after reviewing all 152 complete definitions and terminal histories, without reading a Campaign139 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price or forward return.

performance_forecast_snapshot.point_in_time_limit: The file is a current public historical-event snapshot and may contain later revisions or omissions; it is not an exchange-grade immutable point-in-time archive.

quarterly_quality_snapshot.point_in_time_limit: The file retains the earliest visible notice per instrument and report period from a current public snapshot; later corrections may not reproduce the original disclosed value.

finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.name: quarterly_realized_profit_growth_forecast_surprise_rank
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.definition: For the same instrument and report_date, take the latest finite forecast_profit_yoy whose forecast announcement_date is strictly earlier than the realized quarterly announcement_date; compute profit_yoy minus forecast_profit_yoy at the realized announcement and rank the finite surprise cross-section with average ties.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.filters: Exact same instrument/report_date; forecast announcement strictly before realized announcement; both percentage-point values finite; actual signal available only on the first accepted session strictly after the realized announcement; no forecast-type, board, year, regime or sign subset.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.subset_or_combination: One fixed cross-source expectation-versus-realization difference; no old factor score is averaged, gated or fitted.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.reason: The difference isolates information revealed when realized profit growth departs from the latest already-public management expectation. A common shift in both forecast and realized growth leaves it unchanged, distinguishing it from exposed forecast and realized-growth levels.

finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.name: quarterly_absolute_forecast_accuracy
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.reason: Accuracy discards the economically preselected sign of the realization news and creates an alternate operator search against the selected signed surprise.

finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.name: quarterly_forecast_width_scaled_surprise
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.parameters: One denominator and a zero-width rule would be required.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.reason: Forecast precision is already terminal and width scaling would add support, zero-denominator and tail choices while combining that exposed branch with surprise.

finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.name: quarterly_forecast_revision_before_realization
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.definition: Difference between the last two forecasts for one report period.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.parameters: Revision count and lag would be required.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.reason: This remains inside the terminal forecast-magnitude source family and would sweep a new lag/support rule after its exposed outcome.

finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.name: quarterly_forecast_actual_sign_confirmation
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.definition: Binary agreement between forecast and realized profit-growth signs.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.parameters: A zero and tolerance rule would be required.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.reason: Sign binning discards the percentage-point news magnitude and introduces a threshold family whose only purpose would be to refresh exposed forecast and growth mechanisms.

finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.name: quarterly_forecast_type_or_turnaround_conditioned_surprise
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.definition: Compute surprise only within selected forecast_type or forecast_turnaround states.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.parameters: A type mapping or subset would be required.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.subset_or_combination: Surprise gated by terminal forecast categories.
finite_prevalue_candidate_catalog.reason: Forecast type and turnaround are already exposed; conditioning on them would search favorable subgroups and rescue the old event family.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_realized_profit_growth_forecast_surprise_rank
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When the newly disclosed realized parent-profit year-on-year growth exceeds the issuer's latest earlier forecast midpoint for the same reporting period, the positive expectation error may be incorporated over the following three sessions.
selected_candidate.join_rule: Match exact instrument and report_date. Retain only finite forecasts announced strictly before the realized announcement, then choose the row with the latest forecast announcement_date. Conflicting duplicates at that exact latest key fail closed; no later forecast or other period may substitute.
selected_candidate.score_formula: same-event-session average-tie cross-sectional percentile rank of the finite raw surprise
selected_candidate.availability_rule: The candidate becomes usable only on the first accepted local trading session strictly after the realized quarterly announcement_date.
selected_candidate.event_age_rule: Three calendar days from the candidate effective session; no forward fill beyond that event window.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both same-period percentage-point values are finite and the forecast strictly predates the realized announcement. Never impute, clip, winsorize, backfill, use a later revision, or treat absence as zero.

selection.reason: Only signed same-period expectation-versus-realization news introduces a fixed cross-source relation invariant to the exposed level factors. Every accuracy, scaling, revision, sign and type-conditioned alternative is frozen rejected before values.

decision.next_action: Complete and bind the all-152-definition mechanism audit. Only if semantic independence passes may an exact no-return source/join/capacity/uniqueness protocol and pure formula implementation be frozen before any Campaign139 source row or candidate value is read.
